solutions.title: Buffer nodes
solutions.strategy: Store node references, choose from front/back alternately, then relink.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is read and linked once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The node list stores every node reference.

solutions.title: Split reverse merge
solutions.strategy: Find the middle, reverse the second half, and weave both halves together.

timeComplexity.explanation: The list is scanned a constant number of times.
